g.text: The Gate is the only transport-aware node. The UniversalNavigator holds no data:
the map is the live registry document, parameters ride the passed document,
sessions and the render ledger are repository rows. Every throw ends in a navigator.
Is user-facing prose (asking the user a question and authoring the sentence)
the UtteranceManager's own scope, or a separate "Prose" tool?
Three approved requirements place prose inside the UtteranceManager
carries a "Prose" route name. This diagram draws Prose as a separate tool to
show ONE candidate shape only — the split is the operator's to decide.
Phase 4: Handoff to evaluation — EvaluateCare satellite
Phase 5: User-facing prose (see open question above)
No business logic on the client and no direct FindCare→EvaluateCare call:
cross-server traffic is tool_to_tool through each satellite's proxy, answers
return as internal callbacks, and the main sequences, merges, and streams once.
